from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json

ROOT=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
BUILD="A2Z-V4-SOL-BUILD-20261006-R3"
REVIEW="A2Z-V4-ASTRA-POSTBUILD-20261006-R3-P2"

def final_json(task_id: str):
    env=json.loads((ROOT/"model_results"/(task_id+".json")).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    cp=(ROOT/env["checkpoint"]).resolve()
    if not cp.is_relative_to((ROOT/"models/runs").resolve()):
        raise SystemExit("BAD_CHECKPOINT")
    complete=json.loads((cp/"COMPLETE.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    final=complete.get("final")
    if isinstance(final,str):
        return json.loads(final)
    if isinstance(final,dict):
        return final
    raise SystemExit("FINAL_MISSING")

b=final_json(BUILD)
r=final_json(REVIEW)
files=b.get("files") or {}
rows=[]
for name,text in sorted(files.items()):
    rows.append({
      "n":Path(name).name,
      "c":len(text),
      "s":hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()[:10],
    })
meta={
 "f":rows,
 "rf":len(str(r.get("finding") or "")),
 "rn":len(str(r.get("next_action") or "")),
 "rb":str(r.get("binding_sha256") or "")[:10],
 "d":str(r.get("decision") or ""),
 "ps":str(b.get("proposal_sha256") or "")[:10],
}
detail=json.dumps(meta,separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True)
if len(detail)>315:
    raise SystemExit("META_TOO_LONG:"+str(len(detail)))
print("ERROR_CLASS=R4_META")
print("ERROR="+detail)
raise SystemExit(1)
